title: Opening of Homily II on the Holy Pascha
english: A sacred and royal trumpet has gathered us into this spiritual theater, a trumpet filled by Bethlehem and ignited by Zion, where the Cross is a flint and the Resurrection an anvil.
How shall I express its beauty? How shall I declare its light? How shall I make known the joy within it? How shall I recount its reign within her? By what hand shall I feel it?

With what words shall I greet the tomb that gives birth to life, a memorial of corruption yet a herald of incorruption, a bridal bed that buried the bridegroom, a bridal chamber that raised the incorrupt bride after marriage?
The dead body the tomb guards cries out, while the wonder is God; the dead burial, God the resurrection; the dead women and their tears, God the angels' words.
